source_owner: Henrico County Public Schools via Henrico County GIS
popup_note: HCPS GIS labels these zones 2026–27. The school locator is a guide; HCPS Boundaries confirms official assignments. Quioccasin Middle change begins in 2027–28.

overlap_review_note: Equal-area review of 67 official 2026-27 source polygons found 33,996.7 m2 total elementary same-level overlap, 13,150.7 m2 middle, and 1,712.3 m2 high. Largest elementary pairs are Colonial Trail/Kaechele (5,144.9 m2), Colonial Trail/Short Pump (3,962.4 m2), and Holladay/Trevvett (3,388.8 m2). Largest middle pairs are Holman/Hungary Creek (4,429.5 m2), Short Pump/Pocahontas (3,666.8 m2), and Short Pump/Holman (2,499.2 m2). Keep official source geometry; 34,000 m2 rejects a larger change. HCPS Boundaries must confirm an address near an edge.
